红钨制造的【月轮】镀层。月轮附加属性将会和274级以后的腐化一样，永远平衡的进行: A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Red Tungsten. The Moonwheel's bonus stats will go on balancing forever, just like corruption past level 274…
呼……被这股气息笼罩着，感觉神智都清明了不少。(持有时每个将4-5区域光环-20: Phew… wrapped in this aura, your mind feels a good deal clearer. (While held, each one lowers the 4-5 zone aura by 20%; up to 5 take effect)

幻境符文/绝音蕨的两层吸收使得它几乎完成了光学隐身。什么叫外甲可以被看见？不要在: The double absorption of Illusion Realm Rune and Silent Fern makes it nearly optically invisible. What do you mean the outer armor can still be seen? Don't sweat the details!

将万载冰髓打碎，研磨，注入能量回路中……冰元素固然寒冷刺骨，但广谱能量抵消的特性: Ten-Thousand-Year Ice Marrow shattered, ground, and threaded into energy circuits… the ice element is bone-chilling, but its broad-spectrum energy cancellation still makes it a worthy material.
角色对敌人造成的伤害乘以1.25*(角色攻防和)/(敌人攻防和).加强的原因是你: Damage you deal to enemies is multiplied by 1.25*(your Attack+Defense)/(enemy's Attack+Defense). It got buffed because — if your Attack and Defense both already exceed theirs, do you even need this one!
Each of your attacks delays the struck enemy's attack by 1/2 a round, but Attack Speed *0.7.
Your Agility is multiplied by 1+health ratio/40% (3.5x at full health), but you lose 1% of your HP.
You ignore 50% of the amount by which an enemy's Attack exceeds your Defense, but Normal Attack Multiplier *0.4.
结界湖之心的又一次升级。极寒相变引擎玩的开心吗~: Yet another upgrade of the Barrier Lake Heart. Having fun with the Extreme-Cold Phase-Change Engine~
晶化合金制造的【月轮】镀层。融合之后冰元素可以更好地散发出来，增强威力。: A 【Moonwheel】 plating made of Crystalline Alloy. Once fused, the ice element radiates out better, boosting its power.

晶化合金制造的剑刃。是时候该去做月轮了不是吗？: A sword blade made of Crystalline Alloy. Time to go make a Moonwheel, isn't it?
可以大幅度削弱【死线】带来的易伤效果(5x->2x)，以及持续时间(60s->2: Greatly weakens the vulnerability from 【Deadline】 (5x → 2x), and its duration (60s → 20s).
可以视为大大增强的活性织料。正如看起来的一样，能给不少回血~: Think of it as greatly enhanced Vitalized Fabric. Just as it looks, it heals quite a bit~
刻录许多自增幅符文的布匹，对基因原能和精神念力都有一定比例的增幅作用……至少在它: Fabric inscribed with many self-amplifying runes; it boosts both genetic primal-energy and psychokinesis by a set proportion… at least until it saturates.
蓝金的上位金属。晶莹剔透，具有容纳灵魂的潜质。: Blue Gold's superior metal. Crystal-clear, with the potential to hold souls.
类似于吞噬星空雾岛的那些东西，不过境界略高一筹。可以使用的同时它也是材料。: Similar to those things on Swallowed Star's Misty Island, but a notch higher in realm. It can be used, and it's also a material.

凭它可以招揽冰蓝(出狱后突破至天空级巅峰)和秋兴(出狱后突破至天空级八阶)加入重:
